title: Kitchen Fresh Kenyan Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy Kenyan dish featuring beef and vegetables, perfect for a post-workout meal. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is cooked in papillote for a fluffy and tender result.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef strips, bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, garlic, and ginger to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the beef and vegetable mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with beaten eggs.
Cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil to create a papillote.
Bake for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as rice or roasted vegetables.
